projects.assets.explanation: Moves the recognized assets currently in this project to asset trash, where you can restore them. The project stays. Hidden and unsupported files are not included.
projects.assets.jobs: Finish active renders and imports first; new files can still be added while this runs.
projects.assets.partial: {moved} assets moved; {failed} could not be moved. Check the asset library and try again.
projects.assets.title: Delete all assets in {name}?
projects.delete.explanation: The entire project folder, including all its files, moves to project trash. You can restore it later; it continues to use disk space.
projects.delete.jobs: Finish or resolve the project’s renders and imports first. Model files and other projects are not affected.
projects.delete.title: Delete {name}?
projects.delete.typeName: Type the exact project name to confirm
projects.trash.description: Projects here retain their files on disk and can be restored.
projects.trash.title: Deleted projects
